$comment: Hooks are ENFORCEMENT, not advice. CLAUDE.md is a reminder; a rule gets broken at
exactly the moment it would apply, because that is when it is most in the way.
Everything here is versioned and owned by the guarantor (see CODEOWNERS).

hooks.$comment: Format ONLY the touched files. Otherwise the diff fills with formatting and review drowns the real change.
Blocks: force push, git checkout -- over uncommitted work (it deletes work and git status then shows the file CLEAN), rm -rf, direct writes to production, and merging your own pull request.

Stop.$comment: Will not end a session while fast gates report a finding, or while an audit round has open findings. Disarms itself on its own criterion; AUDIT_OFF is the manual override.
